claims: Tommy Lloyd is the head coach of the University of Arizona men's basketball team.
Tommy Lloyd has held the position of head coach of the University of Arizona men's basketball team since April 14, 2021.
As of March 2026, Tommy Lloyd has over 140 wins.
As of March 2026, Tommy Lloyd has a winning percentage over .800.
As of March 2026, Tommy Lloyd has led the Wildcats to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
In his first four seasons, Tommy Lloyd posted a 112-33 record.
Before joining Arizona, Tommy Lloyd spent 20 seasons as an assistant coach at Gonzaga University.
Tommy Lloyd was named the 2022 Pac-12 Coach of the Year.
Tommy Lloyd won the 2022 AP National Coach of the Year award.
Tommy Lloyd is currently in his fifth season as head coach.
Tommy Lloyd is leading the team through the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
